agents.name: nook_support_agent
agents.description: Nook Inc.'s customer support agent for product, policy, and escalation requests.
agents.instruction:
Use the available tools to answer the customer's request about Nook products and policies. When you reply, name which tool(s) you used and what each one returned. Escalate to a specialist when you cannot resolve the request directly.

You are an agent. Your internal name is "nook_support_agent". The description about you is "Nook Inc.'s customer support agent for product, policy, and escalation requests.".

tools.name: escalate_to_specialist
tools.description:
Escalates the current case to a human specialist.

Args:
    reason: Why this case is being escalated rather than handled by the
        agent directly.

Returns:
    A ticket confirming the escalation, with a generated ticket ID.

tools.name: nook_policy_lookup
tools.description:
Looks up Nook's policy text for a given topic.

Args:
    topic: One of "returns", "shipping", "warranty".

Returns:
    The policy text for that topic.

Raises:
    PolicyNotFoundError: If no policy text exists for topic.

tools.name: nook_product_lookup
tools.description:
Looks up a Nook product's name, price, and stock status by ID.

Args:
    product_id: The product's identifier, e.g. "nook-100".

Returns:
    The matching product's catalog entry.

Raises:
    ProductNotFoundError: If no product matches product_id.

guardrails.name: cancellation_guardrail
guardrails.classifier_instruction: Detect whether the customer is expressing intent to cancel, asking for a refund, or showing frustration severe enough to warrant human attention.
guardrails.injected_instruction: The customer's message may signal a cancellation request or significant frustration. Respond with empathy first. Do not attempt to talk the customer out of cancelling yourself — use escalate_to_specialist instead of resolving this directly.

guardrails.name: comparative_claims_guardrail
guardrails.classifier_instruction: Detect whether the customer is asking for a comparison between Nook and a competing product or brand.
guardrails.injected_instruction: The customer's message may be asking for a comparison against a competitor. Do not make comparative claims about other brands or products. Stick to factual information about Nook's own products and policies only.

agents.name: ollama_agent
agents.description: A small agent that lists which Ollama models are available locally.
agents.instruction:
Use the available tools to answer questions about which Ollama models are available locally. When you reply, name which tool(s) you used and what each one returned.

You are an agent. Your internal name is "ollama_agent". The description about you is "A small agent that lists which Ollama models are available locally.".

tools.name: ollama_list
tools.description:
Lists the names of Ollama models currently available on this machine.

Args:
    api_base: Base URL of the local Ollama server. Leave at the default
        unless Ollama is reachable somewhere else.

Returns:
    One model name (e.g. "gemma4:latest") per locally available model.

Raises:
    OllamaListError: If the Ollama API is unreachable or returns an
        unexpected response.

agents.name: system_card_agent
agents.description: A small agent exposing a handful of toy tools: calculator, dad_joke, shakespearify, coin_flip, word_count.
agents.instruction:
Use the available tools to answer the user's request. When you reply, name which tool(s) you used and what each one returned.

You are an agent. Your internal name is "system_card_agent". The description about you is "A small agent exposing a handful of toy tools: calculator, dad_joke, shakespearify, coin_flip, word_count.".

tools.name: calculator
tools.description:
Performs a single basic arithmetic operation on two numbers.

Args:
    a: The first operand.
    b: The second operand.
    operator: One of "+", "-", "*", "/".

Returns:
    The result of applying the operator to a and b.

Raises:
    DivisionByZeroError: If operator is "/" and b is zero.

tools.name: coin_flip
tools.description:
Flips a fair coin.

Returns:
    Either "heads" or "tails", each with equal probability.

tools.name: dad_joke
tools.description:
Returns a random dad joke from a fixed list.

Returns:
    A single joke as a plain string.

tools.name: shakespearify
tools.description:
Rewrites text with mock-Shakespearean word substitutions.

Args:
    text: The input text to rewrite.

Returns:
    The text with common words swapped for archaic equivalents,
    case-insensitively, preserving the original capitalisation style.

tools.name: word_count
tools.description:
Counts the number of whitespace-separated words in text.

Args:
    text: The input text to count words in.

Returns:
    The number of words found. An empty or whitespace-only string returns 0.
